plate_comment: 1 when the input is more extreme than the fault log's extreme value: above it with configuration flag 0x4 (the maximum is tracked), below it with 0x4 clear and 0x8 set (the minimum); 0 with neither (was protection_condition_eval)

The input's place between a minimum and a maximum threshold as a severity: (input - minimum) * 256 / (maximum - minimum), clamped to 0..0x100 (cm848_clampedDivisionWithBounds); 0 when the input is at the minimum (was threshold_value_interpolate)
